name: Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana
benefit:
1. Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) families receive 35 kilograms of foodgrains per family per month. 
1. Priority Household (PHH) beneficiaries receive 5 kilograms of foodgrains per person per month.
1. The foodgrains are provided as rice or wheat, depending on the state, with fortified rice distributed nationwide.

_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be a household belonging to the Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) category or the Priority Households (PHH) category. 1. Priority Households (PHH) are to be identified by the state governments/union territory administrations as per the criteria evolved by them. 1. Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) families are to be identified by the States / Union Territories as per the criteria prescribed by the Central Government, as listed below. > **Criteria for Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) Families:** 1. The applicant should be a household headed by a widow, a terminally ill person, a disabled person, or a person aged 60 years or more, with no assured means of subsistence or societal support. 1. The applicant should be a widow, a terminally ill person, a disabled person, a person aged 60 years or more, a single woman, or a single man, with no family or societal support, and with no assured means of subsistence. 1. The applicant should belong to a primitive tribal household. 1. The applicant should be a landless agricultural laborer, a marginal farmer, or a rural artisan or craftsman (such as a potter, tanner, weaver, blacksmith, or carpenter); a slum dweller; or a person earning a livelihood on a daily basis in the informal sector (such as a porter, coolie, rickshaw puller, handcart puller, fruit and flower seller, snake charmer, rag picker, cobbler, or destitute person); or a person in other similar categories in both rural and urban areas. 1. The applicant should belong to an eligible Below Poverty Line (BPL) family of a human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) positive person.
